title: Xero Invoices export — data contract
who_uses_this: Validate a client's Xero invoices export before reconciling it in your warehouse, or with POST /egress before sending the same shape to a partner, reverse ETL, or an AI agent.
description: Xero Invoice — core fields from the Accounting API Invoices endpoint. Compatible with Xero's documented Invoice object; not affiliated with Xero. Date and DueDate match the raw JSON API (/Date(milliseconds+offset)/), not YYYY-MM-DD.
